answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded canyon that changes every epoch. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its willow from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. So a sparrow of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal m4lxr.
